title: Automating Conference Video Post-Production with VEditor
description:
Post-conference video editing is notoriously tedious. Organizers often spend weeks cutting continuous room recordings, adding title cards, balancing audio, and exporting video files.

VEditor is an open-source, automated video pipeline that turns raw event footage into finished talks in minutes. Built with FastAPI and PyAV (in-process FFmpeg), it automates schedule-based trimming, title bumpers, EBU R128 audio normalization, and web-based quality review before high-definition publishing.

In this 5-minute lightning talk, see how VEditor works, why in-process media processing beats fragile shell scripts, and how open-source events can publish talks faster with less manual labor.
